research_findings.headline: ANDV-killer is a DEAD-BOOK signal, not a rug signal: m5_volume=$552 / 4 tx vs GAYTES $1,612 / 129 tx — propose hard floor `m5_buys+m5_sells >= 20` on bear_strength entries; plus one novel pump.fun prelaunch-curve velocity-diversity edge that the existing graduation listener is watching the wrong event for.

new_hypothesis.name: prelaunch_curve_velocity_diversity_snipe
new_hypothesis.mechanism: In the first 60-180 seconds after a pump.fun token launches, the ratio of (unique buyer wallets) / (curve SOL filled) predicts graduation odds 5-15x better than raw buy volume. Distributed curves with rapid wallet-count growth trigger the cascade that pushes the curve to the 85-SOL graduation threshold; concentrated dev-bundle curves get filtered out by aggregator/graduation watchers and die before graduation.
new_hypothesis.persistence: Most snipers compete on raw latency to buy EVERY launch and lose money on the 99% that die — wallet-diversity filtering trades latency for selection. Measuring wallet-diversity requires holder-graph reconstruction on the curve PDA, which is not in any standard DexScreener/Birdeye feed and is not what off-the-shelf snipers compute.
new_hypothesis.entry_rules: Subscribe to pump.fun curve account transactions (we already have a WSS listener via pumpfun_graduation_snipe_v2 Phase 1 logger). Within first 180s of token creation, every 15s compute: (a) unique_buyers (distinct signers excluding creator + known bundler funder), (b) curve_sol_filled, (c) largest_single_buyer_pct. FIRE entry between t=60s and t=180s when ALL hold: unique_buyers >= 25 AND curve_sol_filled in [8,30] SOL AND largest_single_buyer_pct <= 4.0% AND unique_buyers/curve_sol_filled >= 2.5 AND creator wallet has not sold. Size 0.05 SOL test; hard stop -35%; scale-out 50% at +60%; trail remainder to graduation event.
new_hypothesis.data_required: Solana WSS curve account subscriptions (already streaming via Helius/QuickNode through pumpfun_graduation_snipe_v2 listener). Bitquery Pump.fun API as free fallback. Zero new paid feeds.
new_hypothesis.evidence: 1) arXiv 2602.14860 names liquidity-velocity the single most informative graduation predictor. 2) VoluTools 'Pump.fun Graduation Gap' study: the ~0.7-1% that hit $69K showed distinct first-3-minute distribution patterns. 3) Live evidence from GeckoTerminal /solana/pools fetched 2026-05-18 ~00:50 EDT: mint GAitmexbTrGKytUPJrSGFFCG9J963pNyUbPTaeWSeT5w ('memecoins') went from launch to $3.7M 24h vol in ~11h, peaked +232% then -18.6% — the exact lifecycle this edge would catch in the t=60-180s window before the +232% leg. 4) Subagent verified the existing pumpfun_graduation_snipe_v2 logger is on the WRONG event (graduation is too late — graduation pop is already partially priced in by the curve buyers); the alpha is in the t=60-180s curve window.

proposals_for_survival_brain.justification: ANDV (the -30.6% emergency stop on 2026-05-12 that produced REQ-017) was bought into a DEAD BOOK: m5_volume=$552 with 2 buys + 2 sells. GAYTES (the +10.7% win two days earlier) had m5_volume=$1,612 with 90 buys + 39 sells — a ~45x activity gap. Frozen-identical exit_velocity snapshots (-5.97% at 4m/8m/12m) prove ANDV's pair was illiquid; slippage cascaded a slow bleed into -30%. NOT a rug (pair still live, liq $69K). The filter is dirt-cheap (fields already logged on every BS candidate). Subagent on-chain check confirmed top-10 holder concentration ACTUALLY FAVORS ANDV (29.8%) over GAYTES (48.6%), so holder-side gates would have blocked GAYTES while passing ANDV — wrong direction. The right axis is short-term order-flow density.
proposals_for_survival_brain.baseline: bear_strength all_time N=28, WR 39.3%, RR 2.09, PF 1.47, pnl +0.0083 SOL, stop_loss_rate 60.7%, avg_win +21.55%, avg_loss -10.32%. Rolling 7d N=2 (ANDV + WORLDCUP-via-CB, but BS-specific: ANDV alone in 7d): 0W/2L, avg_loss -20.18% — recent BS losses run ~2x lifetime average size, indicating the dead-book-into-stop pattern.
proposals_for_survival_brain.expected_effect: Block ANDV and ANDV-like dead-book entries WITHOUT blocking GAYTES. Expected lifetime BS impact: drop ~3-5 historical losses where m5 was sub-20 tx, lift WR ~39.3% -> ~46%, lift RR ~2.09 -> ~2.4 (smaller avg loss), pnl +0.0083 -> +0.025 SOL on the existing 28T sample. Forward: expect to skip 1 in 4 candidate BS fires; surviving fires should show avg_loss tighter than -8%.
proposals_for_survival_brain.kill_criteria: Rolling-10-BS-fires after filter live: if WR < 0.30 OR R/R < 1.20 OR pnl_sol < -0.005, revert. Also revert immediately if filter blocks > 60% of candidates over 30 days (too tight).
proposals_for_survival_brain.min_sample_size: N=10 BS fires post-filter (regime-agnostic — BS is a low-N strategy; cannot wait for N=20 in CHOP).
proposals_for_survival_brain.rollback_plan: Remove the m5_activity_floor gate from bear_strength entry block; the field stays logged regardless so it can be re-enabled with a different threshold.
proposals_for_survival_brain.risk_if_wrong: Worst case: filter blocks a future big-pop BS winner because m5 happened to be quiet pre-entry. Probability low — the lifetime BS WR is built on tokens with active books (GAYTES-shaped). Downside ~1 missed +20% win per 10 candidates ≈ -0.0005 SOL/10 fires, vs. saving -0.0035 SOL per ANDV-shaped loss avoided.

proposals_for_survival_brain.justification: ANDV's logged price_change_6h was -4.39% (NEGATIVE) at buy time, yet the documented bear_strength entry spec requires h6 > 0. Either the rule is missing from the code, was relaxed, or has a bug. The filter spec says 'h24>+278%, h1>+5%, h6>0' — ANDV had h6=-4.39%. GAYTES had h6=+7.32% (correct positive). Independent of the m5-activity proposal, this is a possible production bug worth checking: an h6>0 enforcement would have blocked ANDV regardless of the dead-book filter.
proposals_for_survival_brain.baseline: n/a — code audit, not a metric change. Inspect degen_bot.py bear_strength entry gate; grep for 'h6' or 'price_change_6h' in the strategy block.
proposals_for_survival_brain.expected_effect: If h6>0 is missing or bypassed, restoring it provides a redundant second blocker for ANDV-shaped entries (defense in depth with the m5-activity floor). If h6>0 IS already enforced and ANDV slipped through anyway, that's a data-source-staleness bug to log.
proposals_for_survival_brain.risk_if_wrong: Zero risk; this is a read-only inspection. Worst case the audit finds the rule already enforced and we learn nothing new.

proposals_for_survival_brain.justification: The existing Phase 1 WSS listener subscribes to {method: subscribeMigration} — which fires on graduation, the LATE event. The actionable edge is at t=60-180s after curve creation, well before graduation. Repurpose the listener to also stream curve-account transactions for newly-created mints, with a 180-second lookback per mint. The data plumbing is largely reusable; the schema add is unique_buyers + curve_sol_filled + largest_single_buyer_pct cached per mint.
proposals_for_survival_brain.baseline: pumpfun_graduation_snipe_v2 status PHASE_1_LOG_ONLY_LIVE run-263; currently capturing graduation events only (mint, pool, signature, ts). No prelaunch features logged.
proposals_for_survival_brain.expected_effect: Phase 1 extension delivers the data substrate for the new_hypothesis. Once 7 days of t=60-180s curve features are logged across ~1000-2000 launches, the survival brain has a backtest input it currently lacks.
proposals_for_survival_brain.kill_criteria: If 7 days of logging produces zero curves matching all 5 entry-rule criteria, the gate is too tight — relax to unique_buyers >= 18 AND ratio >= 2.0 and re-log 7 days. Kill the data add if WSS uptime < 90% (infra unreliable).
proposals_for_survival_brain.min_sample_size: 7 days of curve logs; aim for >= 50 candidate curves matching the full gate.
proposals_for_survival_brain.rollback_plan: Disable the curve-account subscription; the graduation listener continues unchanged.
proposals_for_survival_brain.risk_if_wrong: Phase 1 LOG-ONLY: no money at risk. Worst case is some RPC quota burn and a dead branch in the codebase to remove.
